title: Dissipative free fermions in disguise
summary: Recently, a class of spin chains known as ``free fermions in disguise'' (FFD) has been discovered, which possess hidden free-fermion spectra even though they are not solvable via the standard Jordan-Wigner transformation. In this work, we extend this FFD framework to open quantum systems governed by the Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) equation. We establish a general class of exactly solvable open quantum systems within the FFD framework: if the Liouvillian frustration graph is claw-free and has a simplicial clique, the Liouvillian possesses a hidden free-fermion spectrum.
